notes: KRK's official legacy close-field monitor information sheet identifies Model 7000B/BS and specifies the 7000B as a passive two-way monitor with a 7-inch Kevlar woofer and 1-inch Kevlar dome tweeter (2 drivers total), 8 Ω nominal impedance, 91 dB sensitivity at exactly 1 W/1 m, and up to 150 W continuous power handling. The structurally shielded 7000BS is a separate variant and is not substituted. The published 50 Hz–20 kHz ±3 dB range is not stored because the database response-limit field cannot preserve tolerance. The sheet also prints a frequency/dB table but does not specify its acoustic reference level or measurement conditions, so its values are not imported as response points. Maximum SPL 110 dB is not treated as sensitivity. No polar/directivity data are published in this sheet. Source: exact KRK 7000B/BS manufacturer information sheet, linked from KRK's official downloads page: https://www.krkmusic.com/pages/downloads-and-manuals.

KRK's official ROKIT Powered Generation 1 manual table identifies the RP5 as a two-way powered studio monitor with a 5-inch aramid-glass-fiber LF driver and 1-inch soft-dome HF driver (2 transducers total). It gives 53 Hz–20 kHz ±2 dB and separate HF/LF amplifier ratings of 15 W/30 W. The tolerance cannot be represented in the database's response-limit field, and the band-specific amplifier ratings are not collapsed into a scalar power value. The manual's 10 kΩ balanced/unbalanced figures are line-input impedances, not passive loudspeaker impedance. It provides no acoustic sensitivity, speaker power-handling rating, calibrated response-point table, or polar/directivity dataset; those remain N/A/unavailable. This entry is the Generation 1 RP5, not a later ROKIT generation. Source: exact Generation 1 manufacturer manual linked from KRK's official downloads page: https://www.krkmusic.com/pages/downloads-and-manuals.

KRK's official Generation 3 ROKIT information sheet specifies a two-way active ROKIT 8 with one 8-inch aramid-glass-composite woofer and one 1-inch soft-dome tweeter. It lists 100 W total internal amplifier output (75 W LF + 25 W HF), stored as amplifier_output, not passive speaker handling. The sheet's 35 Hz–35 kHz frequency range is explicitly -10 dB and is not placed in the tolerance-free response field. Its 109 dB peak SPL is not acoustic sensitivity; the 7 kΩ RCA and 10 kΩ balanced line-input figures are not speaker impedance. No calibrated response-point or angle-resolved polar/directivity dataset is included in the exact G3 sheet. This is the Generation 3 8-inch model, not the distinct G4/G5 versions. Source: exact Generation 3 ROKIT manufacturer information sheet linked from KRK's official downloads page: https://www.krkmusic.com/pages/downloads-and-manuals.

Fender's exact Blues Junior IV owner manual (amp type PR 295; current product SKU 2231500000) specifies one internal 12-inch, 8 Ω Celestion A-Type speaker. Its stated 15 W RMS minimum into 8 Ω at 5% THD, 1 kHz is amplifier output and is stored only with role=amplifier_output, not as the speaker's power handling. The integrated combo amplifier powers its internal driver; the active flag refers to the complete amplifier/speaker assembly, not to a claim that the bare Celestion driver is active. The manual publishes no acoustic sensitivity, speaker power-handling rating, frequency-response limits, response-point table, or directivity data; those remain N/A/unavailable. No separate A-Type driver data are substituted for the combo enclosure's acoustic response. Source: exact Blues Junior IV owner manual, manufacturer PDF; exact model page: https://www.fender.com/products/blues-junior-iv.
